name: This Light of Mine
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Oh thank goodness, someone civilized!

I came here on behalf of the Church of the Holy Light to make contact with the draenei of the Harborage. The Alliance has no foothold here, you see, and a bit of diplomacy with the locals may help us in that regard. The Light welcomes all into its fold, after all!

However, the road past this bridge is crawling with the draenei's more savage kin. If I am to make it to the Harborage safely, I will need protection. Would you aid me, champion?
narrative.objectives: Escort Father Tuttle to The Harborage.
